Method of Attack: write-what-where condition vulnerability enabling kernel code execution
Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver (BYOVD) attack technique to elevate privileges or execute code in kernel mode
Attack Vector: Exploitation of signed but vulnerable Dell drivers to gain ring 0 access
Installation of legitimate but vulnerable drivers on target machines
Indicators of Compromise: Signed Dell drivers dbutil_2_3.sys versions 2.3, 2.5, and 2.7
Metasploit module implementing LSA protection-subversion attack using driver versions 2.5 and 2.7
